// diagnostic

E1127

`{name}` is bound by this arm, so an arm before it cannot run on into it.

What

`{name}` is bound by this arm, so an arm before it cannot run on into it.

Why

`#Through` on the arm before runs this body without testing this arm's pattern, so `{name}` holds no value then.

Fix

Remove `#Through` from the arm before, or read the value without the pattern binding.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1127: tests/ui/through_refusals.stderr.

Error [jet.ThroughUnreachable]: `#Through` has nothing to run on into
  --> tests/ui/through_refusals.jet:10:38
    |
 10 |         .Square(side) -> return side #Through
    |                                      ^^^^^^^^
 Why: This arm always leaves before the end of its body
 Fix: Remove `#Through`, or move the shared work into a function both arms call
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1128

Error [jet.ThroughNextBinding]: `r` is bound by this arm, so an arm before it cannot run on into it
  --> tests/ui/through_refusals.jet:12:32
    |
 12 |         .Circle(r) -> total += r
    |                                ^
 Why: `#Through` on the arm before runs this body without testing this arm's pattern, so `r` holds no value then
 Fix: Remove `#Through` from the arm before, or read the value without the pattern binding
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1127

Error [jet.ThroughUnreachable]: `#Through` has nothing to run on into

    |
 21 |         1 -> word("one") #Through
    |                          ^^^^^^^^
 Why: This table gives a value, and each arm's value ends its arm
 Fix: Remove `#Through`, or move the shared work into a function both arms call
